name: GoodLife Barbados
summary: A holiday home rental business that also arranges private boat trips through its charter manager, Captain Billy Tempro. The site lists private coastal tours on a 32-foot speedboat for up to 10 guests and fishing trips on a traditional Bajan fishing boat for two guests.
standouts: 32-foot Century speedboat with two Yamaha 350 V8 engines, for up to 10 guests
Traditional Bajan style fishing boat for two guests plus crew
checkNotes: Looks closed: nothing on the site is newer than 2021. The site's sitemap lists every page as last modified between February and March 2021 (Boat page 2021-03-29, home page 2021-03-30); uploads are dated 2021; the Instagram feed on the About page shows "No images found!". The Boat page gives no prices or dates, and every Request to Book button is an email link to info@goodlifebarbados.com. Villa stays are booked through Airbnb and Vrbo links, not checked. For reference, the Boat page lists three request-to-book options run with partner Captain Billy Tempro: Private Charters, a Private Tour and Fishing Trips, on a 32-foot Century speedboat (up to 10 guests) or a traditional Bajan fishing boat (two guests). The site does not say where boat trips depart from, so town is null. Status was unverified; could not confirm the business is still trading from its own site.
